# Keep the Light 1.23.0

- **Plex check when files are added.** Every file you add to Convert or the Queue now gets the same Plex checks as the library scan, so you see problems without scanning the library. Because the check knows your settings, each problem is marked as fixed by them (✓), still there with the setting that would fix it (⚠), or not fixable. The Queue tab also says how many waiting files will still have problems, for example "1 of 10 waiting files will still have Plex problems". Each finished file is checked again. These are warnings only: nothing is stopped.
- **Two smaller resolutions: 576p and 480p.** These are standard-definition sizes, useful for phones and tablets or to save the most space. The picture keeps its shape (a widescreen film becomes 854×356 at 480p), and HDR and Dolby Vision are kept. Both work with NVENC and QuickSync.
